reason: The evidence identifies this package as a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose main user-facing purpose is to add and configure Superpowers-based agent capabilities in sessions, combining a startup bootstrap with access to a packaged skill set. Functionally it is an orchestration-oriented plugin bundle for session behavior and workflow support, not a UI, standalone app, or external service client.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在会话启动时注入 Superpowers 引导并挂载可配置的技能库，让模型可通过现有 dsh 工具按需使用预置技能。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that injects a Superpowers session bootstrap and mounts an adapted skills bundle so sessions can use predefined skills through existing dsh tooling.

capabilities: Injects a session-start bootstrap message for non-subagent sessions
Provides a packaged, dsh-adapted Superpowers skills directory
Integrates with existing DeepSeek Harness skill tooling for skill discovery and loading
Offers a Cordis patch for composition-based profile inclusion
